reason: The plugin is primarily a chat interface customization for DSH Web, with user-facing controls for model-display labeling and chat content width behavior; evidence points to front-end CSS/DOM-oriented tweaks and a dedicated settings page rather than external integrations, automation workflows, or data-processing features.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，在聊天界面提供“聊天增强”设置，用于显示模型厂商名称、调整消息列宽度等界面显示样式。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web plugin that adds chat UI tweak settings, including displaying model provider names and adjusting chat layout width styles.

capabilities: Client-side UI tweaks for the DSH web chat interface
Runtime DOM/CSS changes to chat layout and model selector rendering
User-facing settings page with per-feature toggles
Settings values persisted through DSH settings schema/namespace
Optional helper script to patch host API proxy settings namespace

reasons.code: README and repository description define this as a DSH web UI-tweak plugin with settings switches for showing provider names and removing chat content max-width.
